title: BNY builds “AI for everyone, everywhere” with OpenAI
summary_lines: BNY is using OpenAI technology to expand AI adoption enterprise-wide. Through its Eliza platform, 20,000+ employees are building AI agents that enhance efficiency and improve client outcomes.
